LESSON: READING 13.4.1 SHORT STORY: STYLE

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 13
Topic 13.4: Reading 13.4.1 Short Story: Style

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Reading 13.4.1 Short Story: Style. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How does a writer make a story interesting?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify personification and flashback in a short story
2. read and dramatise selected parts of a short story featuring personification and flashback

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify personification and flashback in a short story
   In simple words: practise until you can identify personification and flashback in a short story. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. read and dramatise selected parts of a short story featuring personification and flashback
   In simple words: practise until you can read and dramatise selected parts of a short story featuring personification and flashback. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Reading 13.4.1 Short Story: Style using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Reading 13.4.1 Short Story: Style in the examples.
2. Explain Reading 13.4.1 Short Story: Style to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Reading 13.4.1 Short Story: Style.
4. Show that you can: identify personification and flashback in a short story

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading 13.4.1 Short Story: Style using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Reading 13.4.1 Short Story: Style important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Read in turns the selected short story,

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How does a writer make a story interesting?
2. Which qualities of a person can be given to animals?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify personification and flashback in a short story
2. read and dramatise selected parts of a short story featuring personification and flashback

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
